zh: 風寒和極光塑造的靈魂
en: Then set off, leaving the shore behind
Adrift in unfamiliar waters
A soul shaped by cold wind and the aurora
Just like this, throwing myself into a journey
A long journey without complaint or regret

zh: 悠遊在迷霧輕罩的海面
如一首旅人彈唱的旋律
en: Your graceful, elegant figure
A soft, graceful curve
Roaming freely over a sea lightly veiled in mist
Like a melody a traveler plays and sings
The lingering echo still curls in the air
The distant ice fields and snowlands

zh: 如今你孤立在長空之下
成為落日和殘月的守望
成為鷗鳥偶然棲息的驛站
再也沒有可回頭的遠岸
en: Now you stand alone beneath the vast sky
Becoming an adornment of tide and wave
Becoming a keeper's watch over sunset and waning moon
Becoming a way station where gulls occasionally rest
From then on
There is no distant shore left to turn back to
Only longing, line after line
Like shimmering ripples of waves
Unfurling over the silent sea

zh: 都付笑談中的往昔歲月
幾度夕陽紅的蒼茫暮色
en: And the ripples at one's side
Enclosing how much
A promise gradually fading away
8 attached to a backpack; and
All given over to the bygone years spoken of in laughter
One by one, also run aground upon
The vast twilight where sunsets reddened again and again

zh: 彷彿知道遠行必定孤寂
如流星劃過空茫的夜晚
雪峰上隨將消隱的霞光
en: As if knowing a long journey must be lonely
Like a shooting star crossing the vast, empty night
Like a bare memory rising from the wasteland
The glow on the snow peak, soon to fade away
In the end, you have no regret, no complaint
Because of you
Resolute as one seated in Zen meditation
Calm as a windless prairie

zh: 月落星起只能無言以對
溫柔的季風會淨化你的心靈
暖和的陽光會昇華你的軀體
越過藍天漫步而來的白雲
飄落於恆古如一的荒茫雪地
en: Years have passed since then
Should be
The vast sea stretches on without end
Sails and harbor
Nothing but a mirage
As the moon sets and stars rise, I can only meet it in silence
When you are weary
A face grown gaunt
Like a sailor gazing toward home
Long since wandering
The gentle monsoon will cleanse your soul
The warm sunlight will sublimate your body
In the season of spring and high autumn
White clouds strolling in across the blue sky
who comes to seek you out
Bringing you home to the south
You will, with a body of purity
Transparent and crystalline
Falling onto a snowfield as desolate and unchanging as eternity
The homeland you long for day and night
